lessons.lesson: Uncertain geometry stays with lead; workers receive a defined executable construction. Stop after one narrowed retry without an artifact.

lessons.lesson: Simple polygons, hashes and local attachment passes do not establish whole-crest anatomy, source style or perceptual uniqueness. Opaque component unions may hide generated tips: P106 covered B/C in three of four groups. P116: prove attachment in both specific child and sheet with interior clearance; union membership alone is insufficient.
lessons.reentryCondition: Inspect the claimed whole scope at native scale against the canonical scan. For component-field retries, preserve subordinate exposure and open sky routes after composition, not only local topology or root overlap.

lessons.lesson: Reorienting the same long two-child fork creates an antler/prong in the upper crest.
lessons.reentryCondition: Change parent turning and child curvature/reach; do not repeat placement/scale-only tuning.

lessons.lesson: Reuse source-bound broad regression evidence while its owning code is unchanged; local edits get affected diagnostics and one render first.
